Title: Node.js Adapter for Hono: Path traversal in `serve-static` on Windows via encoded backslash (`%5C`)
Description: On Windows hosts, an encoded backslash (`%5C`) in the request path decodes to `\`, which the Windows path resolver treats as a separator. `serve-static` then resolves a single URL segment such as `admin\secret.txt` into a nested file under the root and serves it, letting an attacker read static files meant to be protected behind prefix-mounted middleware. Directory escape (`..`) remains blocked.
AffectedVersions: All versions before 1.19.15, all versions starting from 2.0.0 before 2.0.5
NotImpacted: All versions starting from 1.19.15 before 2.0.0, all versions starting from 2.0.5
